analysis:
This PR is a cleanup after the console-ui/ snapshot was removed upstream (#1625). It removes the Makefile ui-* targets and drops the console-ui paths from the test, build and clean aggregates (Makefile lines 95-103 on head). It also edits CONTRIBUTING.md, README.md, docs/AGENTS.md and docs/README.md, removes two coordinator/tests/protocol/testdata JSON fixtures, and adds changelog.d/console-ui-leftovers.md.

No provider runtime code changed. I found no changes to the coordinator-to-provider WebSocket (TB-002), the provider's key custody or the attestation chain (TB-009), App Attest authorization (TB-011), the add-on hold socket (TB-012), the fan helper (TB-010), or the encrypted SSD cache. T-041's cache posture and cited files are untouched.

The removed fixtures are console-test copies only. The changelog states that provider tests keep their own copies, so provider protocol-fixture coverage should be unaffected. I did not verify this against the provider resource readers, since those files are not in the supplied evidence.

The patch cites other removals that are not in the supplied units: the CI job, .githooks, dependabot, and the console-ui architecture doc. docs/README.md was only given as metadata (07b0937cb45ba711:0) plus its file_changes excerpt. I could not verify that no CI security checks, such as secret scanning or dependency audit, were dropped with the console CI job or the Dependabot entry. That coverage is outside this batch and warrants a quick integration check. The loss of Dependabot coverage for the removed /console-ui directory is expected, because the directory no longer exists.

The doc changes keep the ownership statement that backend, console and admin code belongs to the platform. I identified no security regressions or threat-model invalidations.
